name: second-nature
title: Second Nature — Planetary Restoration
author: Radukan
description: Stable Space Age terraforming overhaul. Land stranded on desolate Nauvis with emergency cargo and defenses. Pollution calms native broods but blocks life: cleanse local air and the planetary smog inventory, restore five worlds, and choose symbiosis or eradication. Includes a dashboard, pollution survey, field guide and custom menu art.
